TrashPilot processes selected-folder scans, cleaning candidates, installed-app permission declarations, settings and metadata on this device. It does not upload file data, use cloud analytics, sell data, or track activity outside TrashPilot. Export and backup happen only when you explicitly choose a destination.

TrashPilot provides informational storage and permission tools. Scanning and permission review are read-only. Cleaning is limited to disposable files you explicitly select and confirm. Pro is a placeholder and no purchase is offered.
